content.short: OnRamp.money provides instant fiat-to-crypto services using local payment methods like UPI and PIX for TON.
content.description: OnRamp.money is a fast-growing fiat-to-crypto infrastructure provider that specializes in instant local payment methods to onboard users into the TON ecosystem. It supports highly efficient payment rails like UPI in India and PIX in Brazil, allowing users to buy Toncoin (TON) and other assets in seconds. By focusing on the unique needs of global markets and providing a highly optimized mobile experience, OnRamp.money is a critical tool for expanding the reach of TON to millions of new users who rely on local digital payment systems.
content.meta: Buy TON instantly with UPI or PIX via OnRamp.money. Fast and local fiat on-ramp on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
